title: Relative Property (T), simplices of invariant measures, and existentially closed models
summary: We prove a Bauer-Poulsen dichotomy theorem for simplices of invariant measures associated with permutation groups. More precisely, let $G$ be a transitive group of permutations of a countable set $\mathcal{S}$, and let $H$ be the stabilizer of a point of $\mathcal{S}$. Let $\overline{G}$ and $\overline{H}$ denote their closures in the topology of pointwise convergence. Assume the Polish group $\overline{H}$ has relative Property (T) in $\overline{G}$.
